text:
alix: kicking off a short funnel rollout for ff:llm-kv-tidy at 22:45 UTC. goal: reduce cold-start token penalty without degrading generation quality. plan: micro(3%) -> team-beta(15%) -> public-canary(40%) -> public(70%). step=9m, soak=3m. pinned runtime v2.5.0 for window.
sam: ack. what are hard thresholds?
morgan: hard rollback if p99 latency rises > 75ms or customer error-rate > 0.5%. pause if QA_F1 drops > 1.18x baseline for two consecutive soaks. abort on any OOMs.
alix: deploy-bot, pin runtime and announce each cohort to this thread. add rollout tag to release notes.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: ff:llm-kv-tidy -> micro(3%), team-beta(15%), public-canary(40%), public(70%). start=1755000000 step=9m soak=3m pinned_version=v2.5.0. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-533
support-bot: release-note tag created: rollout/kv-tidy. support channel #support-watch notified.
sam: release blurb for triage: "llm-kv-tidy: compact KV cache eviction + improved cold-path batching; staged rollout (pinned v2.5.0). Watch p99 latency and QA_F1."
morgan: yank commands if needed:
```
# emergency off
/feature toggle ff:llm-kv-tidy off --force
# shrink a cohort
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-kv-tidy public 0
# drain a cohort and tag examples
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-kv-tidy public-canary --tag "drain-investigate"
```
ops-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p99-llm-kv (threshold 75ms eval 5m) -> notify #eng-oncall + #eng-releases. monitor/ooms critical.
alix: decision flow: first monitor fire -> pause ramp and collect traces for 20m. second fire or any OOMs -> rollback to baseline and open rollback/kv-tidy ticket. keep runtime pinned until ML+eng signoff.
sam: if we pause should we unpin? prefer to keep pinned to avoid mixed-kernel noise.
morgan: agree keep pinned. only unpin after a verified patch or rollback.
alix: I'll enable extra sampling and diff-run for the first 12m. tag suspect outputs with #kv-tidy-anom.
deploy-bot: micro cohort enabled (3%) at 1755000123. rolllog: cohort->micro, pinned=v2.5.0.
morgan: sampling 600 outputs -> QA_F1 baseline=0.92 current=0.91, p99 delta +10ms. no OOMs.
sam: ok noise but within threshold. monitoring closely.
ops-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
alix: moving to team-beta in 9m if no guardrail hits. quick reminder: change window closes at 00:30 UTC. if we leave early, open rollback ticket and ping CS leads.
morgan: I'll post 3m aggregates after each step.
sam: thanks, keeping support on standby. :eyes:
